signatureEngine.name: 仿制星徽引擎
signatureEngine.requirement: 装备者的特性与音擎适配特性一致时，音擎效果生效。

refinements.name: 骑士光波：改
refinements.description: [普通攻击]或[冲刺攻击]命中6米外的敌人时，装备者对目标造成的物理伤害提升36%，持续8秒。
refinements.descriptionEn: Increases the equipper's Physical DMG against the target by 36% for 8s upon hitting an enemy at least 6 meters away with a Basic Attack or Dash Attack.

basic.name: 普通攻击：火力全开
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动穿透攻击，造成物理伤害；
连点或长按时，可以进入蹲姿射击，延长射击的持续时间；
蹲姿射击途中拖曳摇杆时，可以发动翻滚射击，调整身位并造成物理伤害；
蹲姿射击途中停止连点或松开长按时，对前方敌人发动终结射击，造成物理伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes a piercing attack, dealing Physical DMG.
Repeatedly press or hold to enter Crouching Shot to extend the attack duration.
Drag the joystick during Crouching Shot to launch Rolling Shot and adjust the character's position, dealing Physical DMG.
Stop pressing or holding during Crouching Shot to launch Finishing Shot at enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

special.name: 特殊技：乖乖站好
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方直线区域进行至多三段的穿透攻击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Performs up to 3 piercing attacks in a line, dealing Physical DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：清场时间
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方直线区域进行强力穿透攻击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Launches a powerful piercing attack in a line, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：公平决斗
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动穿透攻击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Pierces enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：星徽荣耀幻影
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对身周大范围敌人发动强力穿透攻击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful piercing attack at surrounding enemies in a large area, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：星徽在此闪耀
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
对身周大范围敌人发动强力穿透攻击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful piercing attack at surrounding enemies in a large area, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：星徽-同伴之力
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动穿透攻击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Launches a piercing attack at enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 回避支援：闪转步伐
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
回避敌人的攻击，并触发[极限视域]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates Vital View.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：要害射击
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[回避支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after an Evasive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[回避支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方大范围敌人发动穿透攻击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after an Evasive Assist to activate:
Pierces enemies in a large area in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text: 比利在[普通攻击]中进入蹲姿射击后，自身造成的伤害提升50%，进行移动、回到待机、被击退或被击飞时增益效果结束。
facts.textEn: Billy's DMG increases by 50% when he enters Crouching Shot during his Basic Attack. The effect ends if he moves, returns to standby, or is knocked back or launched by an attack.

cinema.name: 闪亮登场
cinema.description: [冲刺攻击]或[闪避反击]命中敌人时，比利额外回复2.7点能量，5秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Billy hits an enemy with a Dash Attack or Dodge Counter, he gains an additional 2.7 Energy. Can trigger once every 5s.

cinema.name: 游斗射术
cinema.description: [闪避反击]造成的伤害提升25%；[普通攻击]中的翻滚射击将被视为闪避动作，在招式发动期间获得无敌效果，并且能够触发[极限闪避]，翻滚射击触发[极限闪避]时，将自动衔接[闪避反击]。
cinema.descriptionEn: Billy's Dodge Counter DMG increases by 25%. Rolling Shots during his Basic Attacks count as dodges, making Billy Invulnerable during skill activation and able to trigger Perfect Dodges. When a Rolling Shot triggers a Perfect Dodge, it will automatically follow up with a Dodge Counter.

cinema.name: 星徽骑士的教导
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 星徽-惩戒弹药
cinema.description: [强化特殊技]命中敌人时，招式的暴击率随自身与目标之间的距离而提升；比利与目标距离越近，提升效果越显著，最高提升32%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Billy hits an enemy with his EX Special Attack, the skill's CRIT Rate increases based on the distance from the enemy. The closer he is to the target, the greater the effect, up to a maximum increase of 32%.

cinema.name: 失落技术构造体
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 星徽-英雄时刻
cinema.description: 累计命中敌人10次或触发[极限闪避]时，比利造成的伤害提升6%，最多叠加5层，被敌方击退或击飞后增益效果重置。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Billy accumulates 10 hits on enemies or triggers a Perfect Dodge, his DMG increases by 6%, stacking up to 5 times and lasting until he's knocked back or launched by an attack.
